statement: For n>=3, if 2n-2 spheres with positive real radii and centers affinely spanning R^n have finitely many complex common tangent affine lines, their number is at most 3*2^(n-1). Part(b) attains this bound with distinct real lines, so the generic complex count is 3*2^(n-1). The projective formulation has an excess component at infinity which is not included in this affine count.
